# iotkit

> A no_std Rust firmware kit for ESP32 smart devices (esp-hal 1.2, Embassy): Matter over Wi-Fi and Thread (any Matter controller), Home Assistant over the ESPHome API or MQTT, Wi-Fi setup, signed OTA updates with automatic rollback, battery devices (deep sleep, Matter ICDs). A device's main lists its entities and calls `iotkit::start`. 0.1 is released from git (not on crates.io yet); depend on the git repository.

Crates: `iotkit` (what a device depends on; chip feature such as `esp32c6`), `iotkit-core` (chip-independent, re-exported by `iotkit`), `iotkit-build` (the project's build-dependency). CLI: `cargo iotkit` (`new`, `keygen`, `build`, `verify`, `flash`, `ota push`, `ota publish`, `web`). API docs: `cargo doc -p iotkit --open` in a project.

## Guide

- [Introduction](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/introduction.html): what iotkit does, iotkit and ESPHome, status, chips
- [Getting started](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/getting-started.html): tools, `cargo iotkit new`, first flash, Wi-Fi setup
- [Building a Matter device](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/matter.html): Wi-Fi or Thread, `cargo iotkit new`, Matter device types, pairing and multi-admin, updates, attestation
- [Coming from ESPHome](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/coming-from-esphome.html): each YAML block and its iotkit code
- [Install from the browser](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/install-from-browser.html): ESP Web Tools page from `cargo iotkit build`
- [Entities and settings](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/entities.html): entity kinds, keeping their state (`.remember()`), DeviceClass, Unit, Config, Setting
- [Components and drivers](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/components.html): relay, binary_input, button, dimmer, fan, rgb_light, poll, filters, any embedded-hal driver; status LEDs (`status_led`, `status_rgb`, `iotkit::status`)
- [Home Assistant](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/home-assistant.html): the ESPHome API, MQTT discovery and topics, a test setup
- [Updates](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/updates.html): signed OTA, rollback, the health check per network, updates from Home Assistant and over Matter (Thread), keys
- [Battery devices](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/battery.html): deep sleep with `start_sleepy` (MQTT, ESPHome API), pairing mode and a wake-up button; a Matter ICD over Thread with `matter-icd` (sleepy end device)
- [Only what the device uses](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/lean.html): opt-out features, IOTKIT_HOSTNAME, IOTKIT_TOPIC_PREFIX
- [Console, logs, editor](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/console.html): USB console commands, ESP_LOG
- [Troubleshooting](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/troubleshooting.html)
- [Upgrading](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/upgrading.html): what to change in a project for each breaking release
- [Examples](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/examples.html): devkit, showcase, sleepy, lean, thread-light, ble-beacon
- [Working on iotkit](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/contributing.html): repository layout, first commands
- [Roadmap](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/roadmap.html)
